criteria.requirement: Initially request sufficient left/right rows or cardinality evidence, exact join arguments and intended relationship. Attribute only disclosed reproduction behavior to pinned join semantics; no invented duplicate keys, production data or library defect. insufficient_information is valid when evidence cannot be supplied.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
